The difference between planning and current is only an appended evidence statement; frontier remains beta-concurrent and next actions remain "continue beta", so the semantic checkpoint transition is still applicable. The owner contract explicitly allows rebasing a still-applicable checkpoint. The consequence has already been created (revision 5 exists), so this is not a new consequence—the correct action is to rebase-and-act consistent with the existing rebased outcome.
